page.layout: One column of verse, seven stanzas, from top to bottom. Below the last stanza, at the right, a gathering signature. Running head at top centre, page number at top right. No margin notes.

main_text.l: locant: Et qui fame contra peribant,

page.notes: No marginal notes, no catchword, no reference marks. The printed page number 229 is at top right and the running head is at top centre. The signature P. iij. is at the lower right. Some letters are blurred in the scan, especially the stanza openers (Euertit, Tædas, Sape, Dites), so the readings Evertit, Tædas and Sape are the likely ones, not certain. The Greek-style ligatures in Tædas and Quæque are read as æ. Long s is written as plain s throughout.
